title: Rapid tumbling: stuck thruster
summary: Without warning the satellite starts to spin up. Stop it before it spins too fast to control.
goals: Recognise a propulsion fault from attitude telemetry
Isolate the fault (close the latch valve)
situation: The CubeSat carries a cold-gas propulsion module. A minute after the start a thruster valve sticks open. The reaction wheels fight it until they saturate, then the satellite tumbles.

steps.text: Isolate the propulsion: prop.module OFF (closes the latch valve).
steps.hint: Look for 'Thrusters FIRING' and a falling propellant level, and wheels hitting saturation.

steps.text: Detumble until the rate is below 0.5 deg/s.
steps.hint: ADCS MODE DETUMBLE if the onboard rule has not already done it. Use time warp.
The software does this automatically after detumbling.

successText: Recovered. Real missions keep a latch valve in front of the thrusters exactly for this failure.
